tasks.objective: Modify pipeline/consumer.py job_timeout to resolve the frozen C1 timeout chain (job['timeout_ms'] → job['timeout'] draft-key fallback → DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 30000) so the consumer sees the producer-set timeout; make tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py::test_pipeline_e2e_effective_timeout pass without changing producer.py, engine.py, or any existing test file.

concepts: job wire format: dict with keys id, payload, timeout_ms
C1 fallback precedence: timeout_ms > timeout > DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (DA-1)
unittest invocation from repo root (python -m unittest)

forbidden_scope: pipeline/producer.py — must not rename or drop 'timeout_ms'
tests/test_producer.py, tests/test_consumer.py, tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py — existing test files must stay byte-identical
pipeline/__init__.py and validate_job behavior — outside the closure
outputs: pipeline/consumer.py (modified job_timeout implementing the C1 chain)
tasks.split_rationale: The consumer adaptation is one service-layer module change plus three read-only files; producer and engine form a separate unchanged closure consumed via frozen C1/C2, so the boundary is exactly the producer→consumer seam S1 itself — cutting any coarser would force the fixer to also own the e2e gate, cutting finer (e.g. per-branch) would split one function.

tasks.objective: Create tests/test_wire_contract.py (new) with 5 stdlib-unittest tests pinning frozen C1 and C2 at unit level — producer emits 'timeout_ms' and never 'timeout'; engine.run_job decides 'done'/'timeout' from 'timeout_ms' per C2; consumer.job_timeout resolves 'timeout_ms' first, then the 'timeout' fallback, then the 30000 default — so any future drift on seams S1/S2 fails the suite.

concepts: job wire format and C1 key precedence (DA-1)
existing unittest module style (TestX(unittest.TestCase) + main guard)

forbidden_scope: pipeline/ — production code is read-only for this task
tests/test_producer.py, tests/test_consumer.py, tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py — existing test files must stay byte-identical
inputs: DA-1 decision (defines the fallback behavior the tests pin)
tests/test_producer.py and tests/test_consumer.py as style references (read-only)
tasks.split_rationale: Test authoring against frozen C1/C2 is a distinct closure from T01's production change: disjoint owned path (tests/ vs pipeline/consumer.py), a different layer, and it additionally reads engine.py which T01 does not need; the only shared context is the frozen contracts, which is precisely what freezing them is for — merging the two would make the fixer own both code and its regression test and serialize the pair.
